youtube.baslik: Can a remote health session be recorded without the patient's permission? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: In Türkiye, remote health services are governed by the Regulation on the Provision of Remote Health Services of February 10, 2022. Under Article 12, a session cannot be recorded on video or audio without the explicit consent of both parties; Article 14 prohibits forcing a person booking an appointment to receive remote care; and under Article 9, the patient is told in advance that remote care cannot be equivalent to in-person care. This is not legal advice; check the current legislation.
